events.factual_description: Billboard Live Yokohama presents .ENDRECHERI. on October 13 and 14, 2026, with two stages each day at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM. Billboard identifies the engagement as .ENDRECHERI.'s first appearance at Billboard Live and describes Tsuyoshi Domoto's creative project as centered on funk, inspired by P-Funk founder George Clinton, while crossing Japanese culture, fashion and art. The Yokohama engagement opens a three-city Billboard Live tour that continues in Osaka on November 16-17 and Tokyo on November 30. The official Billboard schedule lists single-seat music charges from ¥14,300 to ¥15,900 and also lists a two-person DX Seat DUO product at ¥32,900. The official event page currently bills only .ENDRECHERI.; no supporting musicians are named.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is not Domoto's fame; it is what happens when .ENDRECHERI.'s funk-first world moves into Billboard Live for the first time. The project has spent years treating George Clinton and P-Funk as a genuine musical lineage rather than a costume, then folding that groove into a distinctly Japanese cross-genre vocabulary. Four close-range Yokohama sets make the first Billboard chapter a useful place to hear that identity at club scale.
en.trip_verdict: If a Kanto evening is open on October 13 or 14, choose whichever Yokohama set fits cleanly and build the outing around Minatomirai/Kitanaka. I would not bend a Japan itinerary around it: four local sets plus later Osaka and Tokyo stops leave enough flexibility to keep a rarer master, one-off lineup or premiere ahead of it.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho no es la fama de Domoto, sino lo que pasa cuando el universo de funk de .ENDRECHERI. entra por primera vez a Billboard Live. El proyecto lleva años tratando a George Clinton y al P-Funk como una genealogía musical real, no como disfraz, y luego mete ese groove en un vocabulario japonés que cruza géneros. Cuatro sets de cerca en Yokohama hacen de este primer capítulo de Billboard un buen lugar para escuchar esa identidad a escala de club.
es.trip_verdict: Si queda libre una noche en Kanto el 13 o 14 de octubre, escogería el set de Yokohama que embone mejor y armaría la salida alrededor de Minatomirai/Kitanaka. No doblaría un itinerario por Japón para forzarlo: cuatro sets locales y fechas posteriores en Osaka y Tokio dejan suficiente margen para mantener por delante a un maestro más escaso, una alineación irrepetible o un estreno.
